bird_1037.sql: SELECT SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0 / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992';

SELECT (SUM(pa.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot FROM Player_Attributes AS pa INNER JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992
